title: Document effective query patterns
description: Write up which query styles produce the best results for clinical use (e.g. 'ACC guidelines for X', 'evidence for Y in Z patients').

executionHistory.summary: Compiling effective query patterns based on successful retrieval tests across chest pain, AF anticoagulation, TAVR conduction, non-statin therapy, and HFpEF topics.

Effective query patterns documented from live tests: (1) Condition + setting + action (e.g., acute chest pain + ED + disposition) for pathway retrieval; (2) Disease + intervention + context (AF + anticoagulation + periprocedural) for decision pathways; (3) Procedure + complication + management (TAVR + conduction disturbance + pacemaker) for focused consensus docs; (4) Therapy class + biomarker + risk context (non-statin + LDL + ASCVD risk) for pharmacologic guidance; (5) Syndrome + phenotype + management (HF + preserved EF + management) for condition-specific pathways. Hybrid strategy returned highest relevance in current corpus.
